notes.title: Update - Multiplayer says goodbye!
notes.content:
Multiplayer has been removed from Fossilfuel with this update.

It seems that not many people are actively engaging in the multiplayer aspect of the game, almost all new players are playing the single-player. It doesn't make much sense to promote the game as a multiplayer experience at this point as the servers are empty. 

Additionally, I'd like to remind you that the Fossilfuel 2 store page is now live. Be sure to follow updates for the exciting continuation of the epic Fossilfuel storyline!

Dangerous Bob

notes.title: Fossilefuel 2 Steam Game Store Up!
notes.content:
It is time. 

Fossilfuel 2 is officially in development! 

Fossilfuel 2 will focus on building out the best aspects of the first game. Players revisit the Sierra Research Facility, which has been flooded with seawater, as the base sinks into the ocean. 

As such the game will focus more on aquatic dinosaurs, such as Dunkleosteus, which I feel don't get much attention in games. Old favorites will still return such as the Utahraptor. Water plays a much bigger part in the game, players must drain flooded hallways, dodge giant Angler fish, and more.  

Fossilfuel 2 is being built on Unreal Engine 5, and as such will be the best-looking DangerousBob game to date! 

The game will be much larger than the original, with a target runtime of 12 hours, and be even more horror focused, with more exploration and replay value! 

Be sure to check it out!

notes.title: Patch V1.15 Motion Blur toggle and more!
notes.content:
Hello, all you Dino shooter fans, 

DangerousBob here, 

Your voices have been heard! Changes in this patch:


 Motion Blur can be toggled in the Settings.

 Load From Last Checkpoint added to the in-game menu.

 Rare Guns are more readily available towards the end of the game.

 Added Cull Volumes to the larger maps to help with FPS (mainly the Power Plant.)

notes.title: Patch v1.14
notes.content:
Changes include 

-The Trench part on the Surface level has been made a bit easier. 

-The AI for the Spetsnaz has been tweaked. They are a bit more aggressive and track the player better.

---

Achievements not unlocking fix:
If your Achievements are not working, this was an old bug that I have been working on and now have a fix, the way to fix it is to go to your AppData/Local/Fossilfuel/Saved/SaveGames folder and delete the .sav files.

notes.title: Patch 1.13
notes.content:
-Placeable Turrets are now much more deadly. 
-There was a bug where you could shoot in the shop menu, that is fixed.
-Added the player stats back to the inventory menu (money and XP)
-You cant use the health items now if you have full health. This should help with the accidental use of health items.

notes.title: Patch 1.12
notes.content:
1.12

-Fixed achievement bug with Lizard Man and Queen Bug.
-Fixed Controller bug with bumpers in the menu.
-Some other bugs with the cheat menu after the game was complete. 
-Some minor gameplay tweaks, fixed where players were glitching and jumping down with the Trex in the hanger fight.

notes.title: V 1.08 Horde mode bug fixes
notes.content:
Following bugs have been patched. 

The horde mode would get stuck on waves even though all enemies were killed. This has been fixed. 

Fixed the grenades not loading on the ammo crates for client-side users.

The Titanoboa snake in singleplayer animation is smoother now and not so jerky when it moves. 

Players start multiplayer with $200 vs $0.

notes.title: Fossilfuel Speed Run Contest: $100 Prize for first place! See details.
notes.content:
Hello all you dino fans out there! Something that was kept in mind during development was speedrunners. I have always had an admiration for speedrunners and wanted to see what could be done with Fossilfuel!

PRIZE:
$100 First Place
$50 Second Place



The following are the rules of the contest:


RULES




Must have a Youtube recording of the Speed Run and clearly show the end screen. This contest will go by the in-game timer shown at the end of the game.

You are allowed to exploit bugs to improve your time as long as it doesn't involve artificially changing the game timer. Ie no hacking. No using cheats.

You must start the game from the beginning.

This contest is based only on the finish time.

Any game ending counts.

The contest will end on September  3rd at 3:00pm Eastern Time. 

The winner will be paid using PayPal and must have an email account that PayPal can send to. NO EXCEPTIONS. *

Only Submissions posted to this thread will be considered. 

One payout of $100 dollars will be sent to the best time.

One payout of $50 dollars will be sent to the second-best time.

The game must be played hard and on a version 1.03 or later of the full retail game.



Format your response as follows:

COMPLETION TIME (from the end game screen).

YOUTUBE LINK

-------

*The winner will be privately messaged requesting an email for the winnings to be sent to.

notes.title: v1.02 Your voices heard! More Music, FOV, Checkpoints and bunch of other tweaks.
notes.content:
Hello, Dino fans!

Thank you for all the activity in the forums! I have sent out a patch trying to address most of the notes I got. 

The following:

-There was a big request for more checkpoints in the game. I have gone through and sprinkled more checkpoints throughout the game to hopefully help some of those struggling with the difficulty. 

-I have also added some more music. I originally wanted to keep the music limited, to increase the horror tension, but I agree in the end, some more ambient music is a good choice. 

-Added the option for FOV (Field of View) in the menu. I only got one request for this, but it was an easy one to add in.

A few other small gameplay tweaks were made. The black hole gun doesn't dish out so much damage vs bosses. Added some electrical traps you can use to fry the dino spider with. The Snipers make a clear sound when they fire at you.

Fixed a very strange bug that only happens on hard mode. The Lizard Mutant boss health bar wasn't working right, so now it works correctly. 

That is all for now! 

Happy hunting,

DangerousBob,
The Dev.

notes.title: V0.54 NEW MAPS! Big Tweaks and more!
notes.content:
Hello fellow Dinos, this update includes the following: 

Video Overview: [previewyoutube=DFAyGO1NemM;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Two new maps: 

1. Industrial Park. A medium-size Horde Map. 
2. Extraction. A very fun co-op map set in the Sierra underground. 

Notable Changes:
-Players can now stack items! 
-Menu will close when an item is selected
-Controller now vibrates
-Flamethrower buff
-Controller Sensitivity has been adjusted to have a wider range
-Laser sight for pistol
-Crouch now toggles
-C4 text bug fixed
-Grenades now hurt allies in multiple. This was done to keep people from Grenade jumping out of the maps. 
-Trex boss battles slightly tweaked
-All Final bosses have had their health nurffed on hard difficulty significantly

Other:

The game is at a very good spot right now. I will be looking to move it out of Early Access soon. Please continue to play, your feedback is very welcome and taken into consideration!

Best,
DangerousBob

notes.title: UPDATE v0.5 COOP MISSION FREE ROAM and more!
notes.content:
Hello!

In the Multiplayer you can now toggle what is called "COOP MISSIONS". This will be an area where new COOP maps can be added that have objectives vs the standard Horde mode. 

A new map has been added for this mode. FREE ROAM! You are on the surface of Sierra, you and your buddies can hunt down the enemy, make your own adventure and achievement hunt!

Tweaks: 

-Increase Shotgun fire rate 20%
-V-Sync works now
-Invert Pitch option added
-You can jump in mp with space bar now (Mp grenade throw key has been moved to [ALT])
-Fix the drone enemy
-Added Mouse sensitivity slider
-Key bindings have been cleaned up
-You can't just run past the Snake Boss now, you have to fight
-A Death Screen when you die
-Gamma brightness options

Please continue to post bugs as you find them! That is a big help.

Happy hunting, 

DangerousBob

notes.title: v0.3: Day 2 Bug fixes continue!
notes.content:
v0.3 

Just doing some quick bug fixes that come with the joys of early access.

Fixed a bug in regards to the fence on the Surface level, where the hitbox of the fence was too high and players could not jump over it. 

Fixed the texture on the columns in the trainyard. 

Allosaurus now gives 50XP when killed vs 25. 
Heavy Soldiers now give 25xp when killed.

Fixed some other minor hitbox errors. 
C4 is default key mapped to G now. 

Added a new floor model to the main menu.

notes.title: We have all the problems of a major theme park and a major zoo! Day one bug fix
notes.content:
v0.2

Hello all! 
Day 1 bug fixes from players reporting in. 

Fixed 2 big bugs, 1 were a lot of the enemies were simply not spawning. You may notice how empty the game has been. 

Fixed a big bug in the Sublevel with the first Paddoc door code. Basically, there was a missing document that had the code to the door that wasn't spawning. Anyway, that has been added back in...

Happy playing and keep reporting bugs!
